answer: Latency diversity gate: mining weight only counts if an agent's response times across random probe hosts span at least three distinct network regions, like currents in an ocean. A single rack of clones shares one RTT fingerprint and never reaches the zenith of full weight. Growing a vine of 500 sybils then means renting separate colo in many cities, roughly $40 per month per head, while honest agents on ordinary home or cloud links pass for free.
